values.meaning: maximum stacks of Rising Spell Force

mechanics.claim: Ezreal gains a stack for each enemy hit by his abilities, refreshing duration on subsequent hits.
mechanics.quote: generates a {{tip|stack}} of ''Rising Spell Force'' for each enemy hit by his {{tip|abilities}}, lasting for 6 seconds, refreshing on subsequent hits

mechanics.claim: Attack speed bonus is capped at 50% (5 stacks x 10%).
mechanics.quote: up to a maximum of {{as|50%|attack speed}}

mechanics.claim: Stacks are gained even if the ability hit was blocked by a spell shield.
mechanics.quote: ''Rising Spell Force'' will stack even if the abilities hit were blocked by {{tip|spell shield|spell shields}}
